limitations: Procedural teaching scenery with illustrative colors, brightness, shapes and sizes. The close clouds use bounded additive billboards and fixed source parallax; this does not calculate gas dynamics, volumetric scattering, extinction or calibrated nebula photometry. Functional and scoped accessibility checks do not measure frame rate or provide a complete accessibility audit.
